title: Converted statement row
description: One transaction from a bank statement, one row per transaction. Every CSV cell is a string. Rules BSA-001 to BSA-006 apply per row.

Account.description: Account name with the last four digits, e.g. Checking 6120.

Type.description: From the statement section the row was printed in.

Amount.description: Signed: money in positive, money out negative (BSA-005).

Own transfer.description: Yes when the money moved between accounts of the same owner.
